story_theme_en: Lin helped the teacher measure the school playground. It was 120 meters long. The teacher asked Lin to divide the playground into 2 parts. The first part is 35 meters long. How long is the second part? Subtraction helps find the remaining length.
helper_tip_en: Have students draw a straight line to represent the playground and write the known lengths at both ends.
think_story_en: Playground = 120 m. Part 1 = 35 m. Part 2 = 120 - 35 = 85 m. Check: 35+85=120 m.

data.content_en: Lin helped the teacher measure the school playground. It was 120 meters long. The teacher asked Lin to divide the playground into 2 parts. The first part is 35 meters long. How long is the second part?
Playground = 120 m. Part 1 = 35 m. Part 2 = 120 - 35 = 85 m. Check: 35+85=120 m.

visual_blocks.title: Length Measurement Model
visual_blocks.description: A bar showing 120m divided into 35m and 85m

visual_blocks.title: Try It!
visual_blocks.question: A wire is 200 cm long. 75 cm is cut off. How much wire is left?

data.question: A wire is 200 cm long. 75 cm is cut off. How much wire is left?

explanation_steps_en: Length is measured using units like centimeters (cm) and meters (m).
When adding or subtracting lengths, all measurements must use the same unit.
120 - 35 = 85 m gives the length of the second part.

worked_examples_en.question_en: A wooden plank is 85 cm long. 30 cm is cut off. How long is the remaining piece?

common_mistakes_en: Adding or subtracting measurements with different units without converting first.
Forgetting to borrow when the bottom digit is larger in column subtraction.
hints_en: Convert to the same unit first: 1 m = 100 cm.
Draw a straight line to represent the length and write known lengths at both ends.

key_vocabulary.definition_en: The distance from one end to the other
A unit of length, 1 cm = 10 mm
A unit of length, 1 m = 100 cm
A unit of length, 1 mm = 0.1 cm
A unit of length, 1 km = 1,000 m
A line that does not curve
Finding the size or quantity of something

test_bank_en.q: A road is 3 km long. A section of 1,200 m is under repair. How much road is still open?
Lin has a ribbon 250 cm long. She cuts 85 cm. How long is the remaining ribbon?
A fence is 12 m long. It is divided into 3 equal sections. How long is each section?
Ai walks 800 m to school. Mali walks 1,200 m. How much farther does Mali walk?
A table is 180 cm long. It is placed next to a table 120 cm long. What is the total length?
Which unit is best for measuring the distance between two cities?
test_bank_en.explanation: Cities are far apart, so kilometers are appropriate.

test_bank_en.q: A stick is 95 cm long. 37 cm is painted red and the rest is blue. How long is the blue part?

explanation_en: Length is measured in millimeters (mm), centimeters (cm), meters (m), and kilometers (km). Always convert to the same unit before adding or subtracting.
